QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Unintelligible
QuestInfo.1: John says that while the symbols look somewhat familiar, he can't interpret them. Find someone in the area who might know about the symbols. Someone like Elpam, perhaps.
QuestInfo.2: Elpam, the Historian from Versal, was able to decipher the symbols Jack wrote down. It turns out that the corrupted Grandmasters in Crimsonwood Keep were Naricain's followers from Versal.

npc.0: For now, you should show my brother's letter to the experts. They may pick up on some clue that I'd miss.
